profiles.name: Marty

observed.description: Very short, close-lying warm tan/fawn coat with darker brown ear areas and a lighter cream under-jaw/chest/underside. Lower belly has visibly finer coverage.
A distinctly projecting, tapered muzzle with a rounded-triangular dark nose and dark lip edge. Facial forms narrow toward the nose rather than ending in a spherical snout.
Dark-looking, reflective eyes with visible eyelid rims. Exact iris hue is unresolved; pupil size and highlights depend on the photographs' lighting.
Soft triangular ears fold outward/down from their bases, with rounded tips and darker inner/folded areas. The two photographed poses have different ear spreads.
Compact limbs, tapered lower legs, rounded individual toes and dark claws are visible. The standing view suggests an elongated body relative to leg length, but exact ratios are foreshortened.
Black-and-white patterned collar, dark buckle and a blue bone-shaped tag. The precise checker/houndstooth-like motif needs a closer reference; contact text must not be reproduced.
A raised, narrow tail is visible with blur in one photograph; its neutral carriage and exact profile cannot be fixed from that view.

Owner-confirmed seated/garment and toy-carrying views show folded ears with pose-dependent spread and a narrow tan tail curved in different poses. Costume/garment contours hide the torso; blur is not measured motion.

authoring_priorities: Match muzzle taper, ear folds, skull-to-muzzle transition and eyelids before adding more fur detail
Keep the coat short; use fine directional hair detail rather than plush or long fluffy fur
Preserve the cream chest and patterned-collar/blue-tag identity cues
Use natural eye proportions and a shaped nose with nostrils, avoiding toy-like globes
Treat concept-sheet rear anatomy, tail curve and illustrated expressions as provisional
Compare the ear-tip height against the jaw in matching poses; retain fold/spread variation rather than a single fixed droop
Use the five owner-confirmed views together; costume and garment silhouettes must not set body dimensions
unknowns: Neutral side-view proportions and real-world dimensions
Exact iris colour and calibrated coat colour
inferred_motion_targets: Separate walk, trot/run, turns and stops
Paw contact and visible weight transfer
Flexible ear bases/tips and a separately animated tail
Natural transitions into sit, lie, roll, bark and paw shake
profiles.additional_identity_policy: M01/M02 and A05–A09 are owner-confirmed Marty as of 2026-10-31. This confirmation does not attribute cat photos.

profiles.name: Lakitu

observed.description: Strongly asymmetric black-and-white face. In the displayed reference, the viewer-right eye lies within a large black patch reaching onto the cheek; the viewer-left eye has a predominantly white surround below the dark crown.
A white central blaze broadens down the nose bridge into white muzzle pads and cheeks. The small triangular nose is pink, with a dark mouth line and long white whiskers.
Large-looking eyes in this held pose, with warm yellow/olive-brown-looking irises and dark pupils. Upright triangular ears have fine light edge hairs; exact iris hue is lighting-dependent.

White chest, visible belly, forelegs and front paws contrast with black crown/ear regions and visible dark side/back patches. The complete dorsal marking layout is not shown. Owner-confirmed A15–A19 extend the dorsal evidence.
Fine, close fur with soft edges; a dark collar and metallic hanging tags are visible. Exact tag shapes and collar motif are not locked.

Owner-confirmed Lakitu views show broad irregular black back/side islands on a mostly white body, white front legs and a dark curled tail. Full tail tip, rear paws and exact patch boundaries remain unresolved.

authoring_priorities: Preserve the asymmetric eye mask; do not mirror its coat texture or give both eye surrounds the same colour
Separate the pink nose and white muzzle/blaze from the dark crown
Keep eyes seated inside shaped eyelids and preserve a feline muzzle rather than a dog-like snout
Keep visible front paws/forelegs white without inventing unseen rear paw markings
Use the held pose as a marking reference, not a neutral anatomical proportion sheet
Use the five owner-confirmed views together to match irregular dorsal patch edges, white forelegs and the dark tail; do not infer standing proportions from curled or held poses.
unknowns: Anatomical left/right assignment if the source was mirrored
Rear paws and their colour boundaries
Standing proportions, size relative to Rio and exact iris hue
Complete marking boundaries and tail tip/length; dark tail seen in owner-confirmed A17
inferred_motion_targets: Feline shoulder/spine flexibility and species-appropriate gait
Separate tail, ears, eyelids and jaw controls
Grounded paw placement, turns, crouch, sit and head-bump transitions
profiles.additional_identity_policy: L01 and A15–A19 are owner-confirmed Lakitu as of 2026-10-31. Rio and mixed-cat A10 identities are unchanged.

profiles.name: Rio

observed.description: Predominantly black crown, face and upper muzzle with a dark nose. A distinct white lower chin/throat/chest patch provides the main facial contrast; no Lakitu-like white forehead blaze is visible.
A broad white bib curves beneath the dark face. The head angle hides part of its upper boundary, so its exact outline needs another view.
The visible upper body is black with fine fur texture and light catching on individual hairs. Shaded areas should retain surface detail rather than becoming a flat black shape.
Upright triangular ears and long light/white whiskers are visible against the dark face.
A rounded resting/loaf silhouette with tucked legs; the face and eyes are dark and partly shaded. This pose does not establish standing body proportions, permanent eye shape or iris colour.

Candidate Rio side/standing views show a black back and long dark tapering tail, white hind socks, white front toes/paws and lighter underside areas. A13 shows pink visible front toe pads and muted greenish-looking irises; exact colour and complete pad pattern remain open.

authoring_priorities: Keep the face predominantly black and preserve the white chin/bib distinction from Lakitu
Do not introduce a pink nose, white eye surround or forehead stripe without further evidence
Use light response and directional fur detail to reveal the dark coat instead of painting it grey
Do not model permanently tucked legs or a rounded loaf as Rio's standing anatomy
Use candidate white paws/socks and dark tail as provisional observed evidence; retain uncertainty on boundaries and accessories.
unknowns: Complete white-bib boundary and underside markings
Standing size, leg proportions and size relative to Lakitu
Precise sock boundaries, tail length and calibrated iris hue; candidate photos extend the evidence
inferred_motion_targets: A feline skeleton and flexible spine with individually planted paws
Transitions between standing, walking, crouching and a tucked resting pose
Separate ears, tail, eyelids and jaw controls
profiles.additional_identity_policy: A-series identities are provisional visual matches. Preserve source observations if owner corrects identity.

presentation_targets.role: Owner-selected rendering/finish references; not substitutes for observed pet anatomy
targets: Natural eye highlights and shaped eyelids
Soft contact shadows and coherent material response
Warm cozy lighting with blue woven blanket accents
Recognizable individual pets in actual gameplay footage
cautions: Do not bake the cover's orange lighting into base coat colours
Do not treat illustrated turnarounds as measured geometry
Do not infer unseen markings or motion from concept poses
Do not reproduce background artwork or private tag text

acceptance_gate: Compare neutral-lit front, side and three-quarter in-engine views against source IDs
Check Lakitu's asymmetric mask in the same displayed orientation before assigning anatomical sides
Check Rio's black-face/white-chin identity separately from Lakitu
Review Marty muzzle/eye/ear proportions before increasing hair density
Label unobserved geometry as inferred until reviewed
Review real walk/turn/stop and ear/tail motion separately; still-photo likeness is not motion validation
Keep the validated 0.9 game and existing source assets available during replacement work
photo_count_note: Four retained photo files plus 19 attached files. A06/A07/A12/A18 repeat existing views at different resolution/encoding; file count is not independent-view count.
